# Epic Fireworks

> > Epic Fireworks is the UK's leading online retailer of consumer and professional 1.3G fireworks, offering barrages, cakes, rockets, fountains, and display packages from Brothers Pyrotechnics, Black Cat Fireworks, and Standard Fireworks.

Epic Fireworks specializes in both category F2 consumer fireworks and professional-grade 1.3G pyrotechnics for weddings, celebrations, and large-scale displays. The company offers single-ignition compounds, low-noise options, and specialty effects including crackling barrages, colored peonies, and fountain fireworks with shot counts ranging from 12 to 300.

## Key Topics

- 1.3G professional fireworks
- Brothers Pyrotechnics
- Black Cat Fireworks
- Standard Fireworks
- Single ignition barrages
- Firework cakes and compounds
- Crackling effects
- Low-noise fireworks
- Wedding firework displays
- Fountain fireworks
- Rocket volleys
- Category F2 consumer fireworks
- Multi-shot barrages (16-shot, 19-shot, 50-shot, 90-shot)
- UK fireworks retailer
- Display packages

## Premium Display Packages

- [Night Long Party Firework Display Package](https://epicfireworks.com/products/night-long-party): Premium 1.3G display pack with large aerial cakes & monster rockets
- [Symphony In The Sky Wedding Firework Display Pack](https://epicfireworks.com/products/symphony-in-the-sky): Premium 1.3G wedding display pack with top-tier professional fireworks
- [Happily Ever After 1.3G Wedding Fireworks Kit](https://epicfireworks.com/products/happily-ever-after): 1.3G wedding kit with comet tails, chrysanthemums & golden willows
